name: Adrian Vale
paragraphs: Educated HumanAge 28 · male · 6 ft 2 in · Weight 190 · Deity: none

Effect: You may automatically recall ordinary information that your character personally and clearly observed, read, heard, or learned. No roll is required merely to remember that information.

An INT-based roll may still be required when the information was only partially perceived, deliberately concealed, experienced while severely distracted, or when extremely precise details are important.

Eidetic Memory does not provide knowledge you never acquired, reveal information you failed to perceive, or grant understanding of something simply because you remember it.
Constructed effects / requirements: Teleportation; Component Requirement; Concentration: 1 concentration point · +2 Initiative
Requirements / notes: Must have line-of-sight to destination; misfire possible in obstructed zones.
Constructed effects / requirements: Deal 1 Damage · Localized; Component Requirement
Requirements / notes: Requires conductive medium; may arc to nearby surfaces; melee risk.

Requirements / notes: Apprentice notes: Provides direction, not precise location. Cannot pass through dense shielding or lead beyond line-of-effect obstructions. Best used repeatedly between movements.
Short (30 ft) · Combat Round · G.O.D. resolution
Constructed effects / requirements: Reveal/Detect; Buff: Buff increments: 5; Radius (10 ft): Base shape
Requirements / notes: Novice notes: Reveals magical/sensory concealment but not deep wards. Allies must be within zone to benefit. Only applies during duration.
Requirements / notes: Apprentice notes: Limited to surface details and faint magical traces. Requires direct contact. Reveals only currently present concealments, not past events.
Short (30 ft) · Combat Round · G.O.D. resolution
Constructed effects / requirements: Decelerate/Slow: Initiative increments: 1; Immobilize
Requirements / notes: If target passes Willpower check, effect reduces to –1 Initiative only.
